name: Five-county Philadelphia regional employment and wages
title: Greater Philadelphia employment and wage production example

regions.label: Philadelphia, Bucks, Chester, Delaware and Montgomery counties

operatorNotes: This engineering example uses the five-county geography in Econsult Solutions' published Chappell Culpeper Foundation labor-market case. It retains original BLS county, state and national QCEW observations for first-quarter 2025 and first-quarter 2026. It reports industry employment and average weekly wages in original nominal dollars. Regional employment and wages use original summed numerators and denominators with complete disclosure coverage. Original source states remain visible. ESI retains its own occupational, training and forecast analysis, client interpretation and recommendations.
